unit.title: Our Tet Holiday
unit.title_vi: Kỳ nghỉ Tết của chúng ta

dialogue.speaker: Linda
dialogue.text: Phong, does Viet Nam celebrate New Years?

dialogue.speaker: Phong
dialogue.text: Yes, we do. We have Tet.

dialogue.speaker: Phong
dialogue.text: At different times. This year, it's in January.

dialogue.speaker: Linda
dialogue.text: What do you do at Tet?

dialogue.speaker: Phong
dialogue.text: We clean our homes and decorate them with flowers.

dialogue.speaker: Linda
dialogue.text: Is Tet a time for family gatherings?

dialogue.speaker: Phong
dialogue.text: Yes. It's a happy time for everybody.

dialogue.speaker: Phong
dialogue.text: Yes, and another good thing about Tet is that children get lucky money.

dialogue.speaker: Linda
dialogue.text: That sounds interesting. Is there anything special people should do?

dialogue.speaker: Phong
dialogue.text: We should say Happy New Year when we meet people, and we shouldn't break anything.

some_any_sentences.sentence: Do you have ___ free time for sports?
Are there ___ interesting activities here during Tet?
